segment.source: Renders the logo and a short statement about the organisation on one side and a newsletter prompt with a button on the other, plus a small row of links. Use it for: the closing band of a campaign page, the end of a one-pager that has no template footer, a landing page that should end on a sign-up. Prefer 'Newsletter Strip' when only the sign-up is wanted, and 'Utility Footer' when full link columns are needed.
